name: We Are Gum
description:
About This Game

A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home.

They move together because they're aliens.

They stick to things because they're bubble gum.

They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum!

Don't question the science.

Game Features:

  • Classic Sokoban Charm: Push blocks, solve puzzles, and relive the timeless fun of classic Sokoban gameplay with a sticky twist!

  • All Gums Move Together: Every Gum moves at the same time, whether you're ready or not! Precision? Coordination? Chaos? Yes.

  • Stick to Literally Everything: Walls, blocks and more blocks. These Gums are so sticky, it's almost a problem (but that's kinda the whole point).

  • Push It, Then Stick It: You can shove stones like classic Sokoban, but don’t push too hard... You might just glue yourself to them.

  • More than 70 hand-crafted puzzles: Each level design to make you think, teach you each mechanics and help you navigate through the game difficulties.

  • Fully animated motion comics: To help you immerse and explore the world of We Are Gum. Unravel these silly little comics by playing through the game!

  • Built-in Hint System: Step-by-step guidance to help untangle tricky movement paths whenever you need a boost.

Accessibilities Features

  • Unlimited Undo and Restart

  • Game is fully playable with keyboard or gamepad.

  • No mouse input is required.

  • No time critical inputs are required.

  • No simultaneous key presses are required.

We Are Gum was originally created during Global Game Jam 2025. The game later won the Game Talent Showcase 2025 and the Best Student Game Award at BIDC 2025, while also being named a finalist for the BIDC Rising Star Award. The game was made using Unity 6.
short_desc: A wholesome yet challenging puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gums that all move simultaneously and try to find their way home. Stick to walls, drag heavy stones, and turn simple steps into brain-melting logical chain reactions.
